tableDescription: Financial performance metrics for orders, combining revenue, margins, returns, and customer/product dimensions.

columnDescriptions.count: Total order line items including returned ones.
columnDescriptions.net_revenue: Actual revenue retained after excluding returned items.
columnDescriptions.gross_margin_rate: Profit percentage kept per euro of revenue after item costs.
columnDescriptions.financial_return_rate: Percentage of sold euros returned by customers.
columnDescriptions.avg_order_value: Typical total spend per single customer order.
columnDescriptions.status: General status indicator for the record or order.
columnDescriptions.ordered_date: Timestamp when the order was placed.
columnDescriptions.delivered_date: Timestamp when the order was delivered to the customer.
columnDescriptions.is_returned: Flags whether the order line item was returned.
columnDescriptions.is_delivered: Flags whether the order was successfully delivered.
columnDescriptions.products_category: Product category grouping for the sold item.
columnDescriptions.products_department: Department classification of the sold product.
columnDescriptions.users_country: Country of the customer who placed the order.
columnDescriptions.users_state: State or region of the customer.
columnDescriptions.users_traffic_source: Marketing channel that acquired the customer.
columnDescriptions.orders_status: Current fulfillment or processing status of the order.
columnDescriptions.dates_year: Year extracted from the order date.
columnDescriptions.dates_year_month: Year and month in YYYY-MM format.
columnDescriptions.dates_year_quarter: Year and quarter in YYYY-Qn format.
columnDescriptions.dates_is_weekend: Flags whether the order was placed on a weekend.
columnDescriptions.__user: Virtual column used for row-level security context switching.
columnDescriptions.__cubeJoinField: Virtual column used internally for joining data cubes.
